inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The manuscript names the closest comparator frameworks, states the shared producer-checker features and the P33-specific owner semantics, and bounds every originality statement to documented support.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Manuscript evidence names the closest comparator frameworks, identifies the producer-checker features shared with them, identifies the P33-specific owner semantics, and bounds every originality statement to documented support.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript genuinely supplies at least one but not all parts of the committed pattern: closest comparator frameworks are named, shared producer-checker features are stated, P33-specific owner semantics are stated, and every originality statement is bounded to documented support.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the revision makes the closest-comparator identification, the shared-feature account, or the P33-specific owner-semantics account less explicit, or introduces or broadens an originality statement beyond documented support.

operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript genuinely supplies the committed locator/path/version/SHA-256/access-condition pattern, or the required unavailable disclosure, for some named artifacts or some required fields, but not for every named artifact with every required field.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the revision removes or obscures a named artifact's locator, exact path, version, SHA-256 value, or access condition, or newly implies retrievability for an artifact identified as unavailable.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Manuscript evidence identifies a frozen fixture set with independently authored expected outcomes and recorded oracle provenance; provides a trust graph enumerating producers, adapters, checker kernels, libraries, theorem encodings, fixture-oracle authorship, and accountable implementers; classifies every shared dependency as allowed, disclosed, or disqualifying; documents verifier predicate kernels whose composition excludes producer decision code; and records producer, adapter, and checker build/provenance hashes.

operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the revision removes or makes less determinate any committed fixture, provenance, trust-graph, dependency-classification, code-exclusion, or hash information, or permits producer decision code in verifier predicate kernels.
